AFWD.justification: Forward multiplication of the three mixing angle sines and cosines drives the flavor partition arm toward the scalar product term.

AREV.justification: Reverse extraction descends into the complex argument of the PMNS elements to isolate the sine of the Dirac phase.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of the amplitude product with the sine factor composes the full Jarlskog invariant.

ENGAGR.justification: Both violating and conserving potentials are held simultaneously in the unfixed Dirac phase before evaluation.

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation where sin delta equals zero collapses the area to a degenerate line.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation where sin delta is greater than zero yields nonzero triangle area.

FFUSE.justification: The fork depths reconstitute the original PMNS matrix exactly, satisfying FFUSE(FSPLIT(matrix)) = matrix.

FSPLIT.justification: The flavor basis splits into distinct SIC measurement fork depths, separating amplitude and phase information.

IFIX.justification: The computed invariant is permanently inscribed as append-only data in the global fit ledger.

IMSCRIB.justification: The invariant is itself the rephasing-invariant area; it self-references without transforming the underlying matrix.

TANCH.justification: The closed expression of the invariant bounds the system, containing the unitarity triangle area as terminal anchor.

VINIT.justification: Before any rephasing-invariant quantity is named, the neutrino mixing matrix holds unreduced complex phases with no defined area.

steps.domain_action: leptonic flavor mixing exists as unphased PMNS matrix with no computed rephasing-invariant area
partition the PMNS flavor basis through the SIC POVM into distinct fork depths of measurement outcomes
on the first fork arm, multiply the three mixing angle amplitudes to yield the scalar product term
on the second fork arm, descend into the complex phases to extract the sine of the Dirac CP phase
recombine the SIC partition fork depths to reconstitute the original PMNS matrix exactly as split
hold the fused matrix as both CP-violating and CP-conserving potential before phase resolution
chain the amplitude product with the extracted sine factor to compose the Jarlskog invariant
the invariant identifies itself as the rephasing-invariant area of the unitarity triangle
affirm the branch where the Dirac phase yields nonzero positive area, signaling CP violation
negate the branch where the sine vanishes or reverses, collapsing the triangle to a line
permanently inscribe the computed invariant into the neutrino parameter registry
seal the system as the closed leptonic Jarlskog observable read from flavor fork depths
